_comment: Exchange trading holidays (full-day closures only), keyed by exchange, dates as YYYY-MM-DD in the exchange's local timezone. Hand-maintained: update once a year from the official NYSE and NSE calendars. Early-close half-days are NOT holidays (the market is open) and are omitted. Weekend-falling holidays are omitted (weekends are already non-trading). A missing or stale entry degrades safely to weekend-only logic.
